name: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
credit: Text: Korean Wikisource (CC BY-SA), ko.wikisource.org 도산십이곡, from the Cheonggu yeongeon of Kim Cheontaek (1728, Digital Hangeul Museum scan); public domain. No authentic portrait is used.
bio: Yi Hwang (1501-1570), known by his pen-name Toegye, was the foremost Neo-Confucian philosopher of Joseon Korea. A scholar-official from Andong in the southeast, he served the court in a series of posts but repeatedly asked to retire, and he is remembered for his debates with Gi Daeseung on the relation of principle (i) and material force (gi), and for his devotion to the study of Zhu Xi's teaching.

After leaving office for good he settled in the hills above the Dosan stream, where in 1561 he began a small school that was later enlarged as Dosan Seowon, a centre of the Yeongnam scholars. In 1565 he composed the twelve sijo of the Dosan sibi gok, six on his purposes (eonji) and six on learning (eonhak). They were preserved in the anthology Cheonggu yeongeon (1728), whose Hangul text, with its archaic letters, is given here.

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언지 其一 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonji 1)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
이런들 엇더ᄒᆞ며 져런들 엇더ᄒᆞ료
草野 愚生이 이러타 엇더ᄒᆞ료
ᄒᆞ믈며 泉石膏肓을 고쳐 므슴 ᄒᆞ료

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언지 其二 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonji 2)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
烟霞로 집을 삼고 風月로 벗을 사마
太平聖代에 病으로 늘거 가뇌
이 즁에 ᄇᆞ라ᄂᆞᆫ 일은 허믈이나 업고쟈

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언지 其三 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonji 3)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
淳風이 죽다 ᄒᆞ니 眞實로 거즛말이
人性이 어지다 ᄒᆞ니 眞實 올흔 말이
天下에 許多 英才ᄅᆞᆯ 소겨 말슴ᄒᆞᆯ가

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언지 其四 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonji 4)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
幽蘭이 在谷ᄒᆞ니 自然이 듯디 죠희
白雪이 在山ᄒᆞ니 自然이 보디 죠해
이즁에 彼美一人을 더옥 닛디 못ᄒᆞ얘

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언지 其五 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonji 5)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
山前에 有臺ᄒᆞ고 臺下에 有水ㅣ로다
ᄠᅦ 만흔 ᄀᆞᆯ며기ᄂᆞᆫ 오명가명 ᄒᆞ거든
엇더타 皎皎白駒ᄂᆞᆫ 멀리 ᄆᆞ음 ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ고

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언지 其六 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonji 6)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
春風에 花滿山ᄒᆞ고 秋夜에 月滿臺라
四時 佳興이 사ᄅᆞᆷ과 ᄒᆞᆫ가지라
ᄒᆞ믈며 魚躍鳶飛 雲影天光이야 어ᄂᆡ 그지 이시리

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언학 其一 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonhak 1)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
天雲臺 도라드러 玩樂齋 蕭灑ᄒᆞᆫ듸
萬卷生涯로 樂事ㅣ 無窮ᄒᆞ얘라
이즁에 往來風流ᄅᆞᆯ 닐러 므슴ᄒᆞᆯ고

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언학 其二 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonhak 2)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
雷霆이 破山ᄒᆞ여도 聾者ᄂᆞᆫ 못 듯ᄂᆞ니
白日이 中天하야도 瞽者ᄂᆞᆫ 못 보ᄂᆞ니
우리ᄂᆞᆫ 耳目聰明 男子로 聾瞽ᄀᆞᆺ지 마로리

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언학 其三 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonhak 3)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
古人도 날 못보고 나도 古人 못 뵈
古人을 못 봐도 녀ᄃᆞᆫ 길 알픠 잇ᄂᆡ
녀ᄃᆞᆫ 길 알픠 잇거든 아니 녀고 엇졀고

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언학 其四 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonhak 4)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
當時에 녀ᄃᆞᆫ 길흘 몃 ᄒᆡᄅᆞᆯ ᄇᆞ려 두고
어듸 가 ᄃᆞᆫ니다가 이제야 도라온고
이제야 도라 오나니 년듸 ᄆᆞ음 마로리

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언학 其五 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonhak 5)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
靑山은 엇졔ᄒᆞ여 萬古에 프르르며
流水ᄂᆞᆫ 엇졔하여 晝夜애 긋지 아니ᄂᆞᆫ고
우리도 그치지 마라 萬古常靑 ᄒᆞ리라

poems.title: 도산십이곡 언학 其六 (Dosan sibi gok, Eonhak 6)
poems.author: Yi Hwang (Toegye)
poems.collection: Dosan sibi gok (1565), in Cheonggu yeongeon (1728)
poems.text:
愚夫도 알며 ᄒᆞ거니 긔 아니 쉬온가
聖人도 못 다 ᄒᆞ시니 긔 아니 어려온가
쉽거나 어렵거나 즁에 늙ᄂᆞᆫ 줄을 몰래라
